request.prompt: A sprite sheet for a video game visual effect: 16 sequential animation frames of a lightning strike arranged in a 4 by 4 grid, read left to right then top to bottom, every cell exactly the same size, no borders, no gaps, no numbers, no text. Frame 1: a faint blue glow at the top. Frames 2 to 4: a jagged white-blue bolt strikes straight down from the top edge and hits the ground at the bottom centre with a blinding white flash. Frames 5 to 8: branching forks and a burst of sparks and a ring of light at the impact point. Frames 9 to 16: the bolt thins and fades, the sparks scatter outward and dim until the last frame is nearly black. Stylised hand-painted game VFX in bold saturated electric blue and white with crisp dark outlines, on a pure black background.
